anchors.paper_title: MNE-BIDS: Organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format and facilitating their analysis
anchors.paper_venue: The Journal of Open Source Software
anchors.reason: MNE-BIDS is a software tool for organizing electrophysiological data into BIDS, cited as a BIDS reference; it does not describe this somatomotor dataset.

anchors.paper_title: MEG-BIDS, the brain imaging data structure extended to magnetoencephalography
anchors.reason: MEG-BIDS is the BIDS extension specification for MEG data, a standard the dataset follows, not a paper describing this somatomotor median nerve dataset.

metadata.methods_description: MEG and EEG were recorded during right median nerve electrical stimulation with left index finger lift responses. Three anatomical fiducials (nasion, left and right pre-auricular points) were digitized for MEG-MRI alignment. Triggers 32 (somatosensory stimulus) and 16 (finger lift response) are stored in the .fif files and events .tsv files.
